test_title: PYST 22: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Change the following sentence from active to passive voice:

The manager might have approved the request.

options.text: The request might have been approved by the manager.
The request might be approved by the manager.
The request might have approved the manager.
The request was being approved by manager.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The manager might have approved the request."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the request" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "might have approved" to "might have been approved&qu
